anzsic_codes.name: Computer System Design and Related Services

merger_description:
Avocet Bidco Limited, a newly formed vehicle that will be indirectly wholly owned by funds managed and/or advised by Accel-KKR (**A-KKR**) and its affiliates, proposes to acquire the entire issued and to be issued share capital of Eleco PLC (**Eleco**) (the **Acquisition**). The Acquisition will be implemented by way of a Court-sanctioned scheme of arrangement. Following completion, A-KKR will acquire sole control of Eleco.

A-KKR is a US-headquartered global investment firm that manages and advises funds invested in mid-market software and technology-enabled services businesses. Founded in 2000, A-KKR has extensive experience investing in growth technology companies across a range of sectors.

A-KKR controls a portfolio of software businesses, including UpKeep Technologies, Inc. (**UpKeep**), which supplies cloud-based Computerised Maintenance Management System (**CMMS**) software. UpKeep is headquartered in Los Angeles, USA and operates in over 60 countries.

Eleco is an Alternative Investment Market listed provider of software solutions for the built environment (LSE: ELCO). Eleco provides specialist software and related services to the construction industry and built environment globally. Eleco’s software is used throughout the building lifecycle, from early planning and design stages to construction, interior fit out, asset management and facilities management, supporting project management, estimation, and building information modelling. Eleco has international operations in the UK, Ireland, Germany, Sweden, the Netherlands, Romania, the USA and Australia, where it operates through its wholly owned Australian subsidiary, Elecosoft Pty Ltd.

Eleco’s software falls into the following software solution categories:

* Planning and Scheduling
* Building Information Management
* Cost Estimation
* CMMS
* Computer-aided design (CAD)/Engineering.

Eleco also offers training, consultancy, and technical support services to support its software.

In Australia, Eleco only currently provides CMMS software (ShireSystem) and staircase design software (Staircon) which is a form of CAD software.

determination_table_content.details:
In making this notification waiver determination, the Australian
Competition and Consumer Commission (the ACCC) has considered
the information provided with the notification waiver application and
had regard to the factors in section 51ABV(2)(b) of the Competition
and Consumer Act 2010 (Cth) (the Act).
Based on the information provided in the application, the ACCC
considers that the Acquisition is unlikely to give rise to any material
lessening of competition, in particular:
a. the parties’ combined share in the supply of CMMS software
to customers in Australia is low and the increase in share of
supply arising from the Acquisition would be small
b. there are alternative suppliers of CMMS software to
customers in Australia.
In these circumstances, the ACCC does not consider it necessary to
reach a concluded view on the likelihood of the notification
thresholds being met.
Given that material competition concerns are unlikely to arise, the
ACCC has determined that the Acquisition is not required to be
notified.
The ACCC considers that the determination is consistent with the
object of the Act and the interests of consumers in promoting
competition.
For more information about the ACCC’s approach to considering
notification waiver applications and to assessing competition
effects more generally, see the ACCC’s guidance on notification
waivers and merger assessment guidelines.
